# voices

THE WHO STYLE GUIDE: three `folio-voice-skill/v1` voice skills, one per WHO publication in this instance's own library, each a directory holding `voice.json` (the RULES, every one carrying the quote it was read from and a citation naming `{ libraryId, sectionId }`) and `SKILL.md` (how to USE them in authoring, review and QA). Under `skills/` because a voice IS a skill: it tells an actor what to do and is bound to processes by name. A voice is DERIVED FROM a publication and is not the publication, so these live beside the library rather than inside it, citing it in the bare same-instance form. `bun run cat check:voices` resolves each citation.

Part of [WHO IRIS](../../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `voices`, holding `voices`.

| file | what it is | used by |
|---|---|---|
| [`who-editorial/`](who-editorial/) | _nothing declares what this holds_ | |
| [`who-guideline-development/`](who-guideline-development/) | _nothing declares what this holds_ | |
